findings.evidence: ship.yml preview (L124-129) and deploy (~L200-211) identity checks now use `node - <<'NODE' ... NODE` single-quoted heredocs; no bash expansion of ${id.commit}/${process.env.GITHUB_SHA}. New contract test `never wraps node template-literal identity checks in double quotes` asserts the pattern and requires the heredoc form in both jobs.

Rollback step opens with `git checkout -- firebase.json` before `git revert --no-edit HEAD`, restoring the jq-mutated tracked file so revert cannot conflict. Ordering enforced by test assertion `indexOf('git checkout -- firebase.json') < indexOf('git revert --no-edit HEAD')`. Additionally `git fetch origin main` + `remote_head == GITHUB_SHA` guard refuses stale rollback.

Rollback re-runs full gates on the reverted source (npm ci, functions npm ci, tsc, lint, static audit, node --test, build:static, python3 http.server + full playwright, LHCI) BEFORE `firebase-tools@13 deploy --only hosting`; then bounded 12x10s poll sets explicit parity_ok=true/false with hard `[ "$parity_ok" = true ]` assertion, followed by `PLAYWRIGHT_BASE_URL="$PROD_URL" npx playwright test --grep @smoke`. Revert-of-revert guard preserved (`^Revert ` grep exits 1).

tests/ci_pipeline.test.mjs new suite `every run: block is shell-safe` (a) spawns `bash -n` on every extracted run: step across ship.yml and nightly.yml (with GitHub expressions replaced by a placeholder so bash parses them), (b) regex-forbids `node -e "...`...${...}...`"` double-quoted template-literal pattern in both files, (c) requires quoted heredoc identity check in preview and deploy.

Rollback contract in `smokes production...and rolls back` asserts git checkout firebase.json ordering, git fetch origin main, remote_head != GITHUB_SHA stale guard, full gate chain, parity_ok flag pattern with hard assertion, post-parity @smoke against $PROD_URL, EXIT trap covers cred_file and tmp, no --force / push -f, revert-of-revert guard.
Rollback still deploys in-run via firebase-tools rather than relying on GITHUB_TOKEN push retrigger. Same footgun avoided; branch protection remains an ops-doc concern only.
concurrency group `ship-${{ github.ref }}` with cancel-in-progress:false unchanged; cron `5 * * * *` hourly cap enforced by contract test.
`.github/workflows/` contains only nightly.yml and ship.yml. Contract test explicitly asserts absence of deploy.yml. No enabling of the old dangerous workflow required or performed.
Reviewer scope: no test quarantine markers introduced; contract test suite counts 34/34 pass locally.

No production deploy or live rollback was executed by the reviewer; production status not asserted. Release author's report also states production was not exercised. This is a scope boundary, not a defect in the workflow file.

evidence: Local: `node --test tests/ci_pipeline.test.mjs` -> exit 0, tests 34, suites 8, pass 34, fail 0, duration_ms 543.

ship.yml preview step (L124-131) and deploy step Use-the-gated-export (L200-215) both use `node - <<'NODE' ... NODE` heredoc with single-quoted delimiter — bash performs no expansion; original R1 substitution bug eliminated at source, and asserted by new contract.

Rollback step: `git checkout -- firebase.json` precedes `git revert --no-edit HEAD` (R2 fixed); `git fetch origin main` + `[ "$remote_head" != "$GITHUB_SHA" ]` refuses stale revert; full gates (tsc, lint, static audit, node tests, build:static, full Playwright on 127.0.0.1:$STATIC_PORT, LHCI) run BEFORE `firebase-tools@13 deploy --only hosting`; then parity_ok bool with hard assertion and `PLAYWRIGHT_BASE_URL="$PROD_URL" npx playwright test --grep @smoke` (R3 fixed).
Contract test suite `every run: block is shell-safe` runs bash -n on every extracted step and forbids double-quoted node -e template literals in both workflows (R4 fixed).

Rollback contract enumerates checkout-firebase-ordering, fetch origin main, stale-guard, full gate chain, parity_ok pattern, post-parity @smoke, trapped credential cleanup, no --force, revert-of-revert guard (R5 fixed).
No race remaining: concurrency per ref with cancel-in-progress:false; heartbeat skip step prevents rollback on no-op runs (`steps.skip.outputs.skip != 'true'` on rollback if:).

Dirty-build risk mitigated: rollback rebuilds after `git checkout -- firebase.json` so build_stamp sees a clean tracked tree and emits build-commit meta; jq mutation of firebase.json now occurs AFTER build in the rollback path, before deploy only.
verdict.notes: All three P0 blockers (R1 shell quoting, R2 dirty-tree revert, R3 ungated rollback) and both matching P1 contract-test gaps (R4, R5) are resolved in the source. Contract suite passes 34/34 locally; release author reports 117/117 across the four node-test files. Production has NOT been verified by the reviewer and no such claim is made — CI must run to establish live behavior. Approving the source; a live post-merge deploy plus a deliberate rollback drill remain recommended follow-ups, outside this review's scope.
